snippet.title: Kanji Drop - A fun way to turn your down time into brain time
snippet.description:
This is a quick introduction to Kanji Drop, an actually fun game where you can not only enjoy yourself, but come away from the experience with knowledge of Japanese! No prior knowledge required!

Get Kanji Drop and Chinese Drop for FREE for iOS and Android!
www.RiotShieldGames.com
